title: Waste and litter draft-action demonstration policy
source_note: Synthetic portfolio policy for this technical demonstration, proposed under the F32-F35 charters on 2026-11-20; the human Product Owner's approval is recorded in BUILD_PLAN. Version 0.5.0 keeps every 0.4.0 rule and changes three things: the multi-issue check uses issue lexicon 1.1.1, which is 1.1.0 plus graffiti (F32); the priority wording lives in this pack, with water across a road and a dog at large added as urgent (P2) and night-time construction noise left routine (P3), following published Tasmanian and other Australian council service standards (F34); and POL-ADDRESS-001 escalates a request whose named Hobart street or street address is far from its coordinates, checked against LIST Address Points (F35). Diagnosis keeps rules classifier 0.1.0: classifier 0.2.0 (problem wording decides the category, F33) let 2 of 20 multi-issue requests in the second blind set pass as waste drafts, so it is not adopted. It is not City of Hobart, Tasmanian Government, or other council policy.
